content: We need a retrosynthesis route with at most 1 step (i.e., direct synthesis from commercially available precursors). Leaves must be commercially available chemicals, total price <= $125. We need to propose a route: target SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O. That's a methyl ester of a carboxylic acid? Actually it's methyl ester of a carboxylic acid attached to a vinyl phenyl and a trimethylsilyl-substituted cyclobutene? Wait structure: COC( ... )=O is methyl ester of a carbonyl attached to a C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C) etc. So maybe we can get it via esterification of the corresponding acid with methanol. So precursors: the acid (carboxylic acid) O=C(O)C(...). And methanol (CH3OH). Both are cheap and buyable. Need to check if acid is commercially available. Let's check is_buyable for acid SMILES: O=C(O)C(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2). Use is_buyable.
